Attached is a short statement of our priorities: minimal downtime for our analytics pipeline, phased migration of 3 services, and a 2-week internal training window for SRE and Product.

Also looping in Maya (product) and our PS team for scoping.

Tom — appreciate the quick update and congrats on sign-off. I put together an initial MAP that embeds the deployment plan, canary gating criteria, and the eval plan you asked for (attached as zenbridge_MAP_v1.xlsx). High-level proposal below:

- Pilot (canary) wave: Oct 18–Oct 22 — 5% of read traffic, shadow write verification
- Expansion wave A: Oct 25–Nov 1 — 25% of read traffic; train + enable feature flags
- Final cutover: Nov 8 — full traffic after acceptance window

Gating criteria we propose (must pass all):
- 95th-percentile latency within +25% of baseline
- Error rate <= 0.5% over a 24h rolling window
- Feature/regression evaluation: automated prompt set pass rate >= 92% (per the eval harness)

Training and enablement
- SRE runbook walkthrough + dry-run: Oct 11–12
- Product/ops training (2-day workshop): Oct 13–14
- Office-hours during pilot: daily 9–10 AM PT

Ive ccd Marissa for CS handoff logistics, Ben for professional services scheduling, and Laura for post-close billing cadence. Im happy to adjust timelines if your PS lead flags conflicts.

Attachments: zenbridge_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owner matrix), canary-checklist.pdf

Best,
Priyom
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Tom / team — added an operational playbook section to the MAP and a compact training schedule (attached training-schedule.csv). A few pragmatic changes I recommend after reviewing your priorities:

1) Canary scope: limit to the analytics ingestion path only for the pilot (reduces blast radius).
2) Rollback plan: automated traffic split back to legacy for 30 minutes if any one of the gating signals breaches for >15m.
3) Acceptance window: must observe stable metrics for 72h at >=25% traffic before proceeding to final cutover.

Evaluation plan (detailed):
- Observability: trace sampling at 50% for pilot, 10% afterwards; synthetic probe every 5m across 6 regions.
- Quality: 1k prompt set run at pilot and expansion; PR curve and sample review by product.
- Cost delta: per-token unit cost measurement during pilot to estimate committed capacity implications.

PS scheduling notes (Ben)
- Kickoff: Oct 4 — 2h scoping + runbook review.
- Dry-run w/ SRE: Oct 11 (2h)
- Training workshop (internal): Oct 13–14 (on-site option)

If this looks okay to you, well convert the spreadsheet into a tracked MAP in HubSpot and add the owners/drive links.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
